description: This file implements the ActiveSessions class, managing active CDM sessions including creation, retrieval, and removal of sessions with thread safety.

classes.name: ActiveSessions
classes.description: Singleton class managing active CDM sessions with thread safety.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ActiveSessions.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::create
methods.description: Creates a new CDM session and adds it to the active sessions map.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::get
methods.description: Retrieves an active session matching the key ID, incrementing its reference count.

methods.name: ActiveSessions::remove
methods.description: Removes a session from the active sessions map, deleting it if reference count reaches zero.
